**Bangla Voice Clock** (বাংলা ভয়েস ক্লক) can now play through the speaker or headphones you choose, and tells you when a new version is out.

## New

- **Choose where it plays.** Under Voice, pick the system default, built-in speakers, headphones or any other output. If the chosen device isn't connected, the clock uses the system default.
- **Update checks.** Once a day the clock looks for a new version and offers it in a window, with what changed. On Windows (installed with the setup) **Update now** downloads, checks and installs it, then reopens the clock. On macOS it opens the download page, or you can run `brew upgrade --cask bangla-voice-clock`. Turn the checks off, or check by hand, under General.
- **Clearer choices.** Voice and announcement style are now separate cards with a larger radio mark, so the chosen one stands out.

## Changed

- New installs start in Bangla with the AI voice, say the exact minute ("দশটা বেজে সাত মিনিট"), and open at login (on Windows, through the setup's ticked box). Your existing settings stay as they are.
- The app now goes online, only to GitHub, to look for new versions (and on Windows to download them). Turning off the checks keeps it offline.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| **macOS** 12 or later | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.3.0-macos.dmg`: open it and drag **Bangla Voice Clock** onto **Applications**. It isn't signed yet: the first time, if macOS won't open it, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and choose **Open Anyway**. Or use Homebrew: `brew install --cask saifulmd0/tap/bangla-voice-clock`. |
| **Windows** 10 or later (64-bit) | `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.3.0-windows-setup.exe`: run it and follow the two steps. SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher: choose **More info → Run anyway**. Prefer no installer? `BanglaVoiceClock-v0.3.0-windows-portable.zip` runs from any folder. |

## Known limits

- Builds are not code-signed yet.
- Installing updates from the app works only for the Windows setup; on macOS and with the portable zip you download the new version yourself.
